steps.title: Two speakers, one answer
body: A short exchange has two people taking turns. When you listen, you do not need every word — you listen for the one thing being asked: a name, a place, how someone is.
مَا اسْمُكِ؟ — اسْمِي سَارَةُ. The question asks for a name; the answer gives it: سَارَة.

steps.title: Four exchanges
steps.intro: Tap 🔊 and listen first, before you read. Then reveal the meaning and check what was asked and answered.

steps.title: Listen for the answer
steps.prompt: What is the second speaker's name?

steps.title: Listen for the answer
steps.arabicPrompt: أَيْنَ الْمَحَطَّةُ؟ — الْمَحَطَّةُ هُنَاكَ، عَلَى الْيَمِينِ
steps.explanation: هُنَاكَ = "over there"; عَلَى الْيَمِينِ = "on the right."

steps.title: You followed an exchange
steps.message: You listened to four short exchanges and picked out what was asked and answered — a name, a place, a greeting. That is A1 listening.
